boundary: Actual NativeStorageAnalysisAdapter fixture scan in its own libtest process plus the real Electron composer and storage status; a synthetic Gateway transports the native progress/result.

timing_method.input: Renderer input event to input-value microtask is separate from Playwright fill/inputValue round-trip.
timing_method.frames: First/second requestAnimationFrame are presentation opportunities, not proof of visible paint. Hidden-window throttling is preserved.
timing_method.native_overlap: Input and frame UNIX timestamps are compared with the first actual native progress callback through native scan return; worker begin, later report and process exit are not treated as proof of scan overlap.
timing_method.first_status: Click to first storage status DOM/frame is distinct from first DOM containing an actual native progress payload.

native_metrics.memory_scope: fresh native libtest worker, runtime and SQLite; fixture preparation, Gateway and Electron excluded
